    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_ir_counts.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_ipm_graph.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_ipm_cache.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)

print('Frozen QOCO127',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
base='/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v128/final'
root=Path('/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v128/source')
exe='build/performance/qoco_numeric_guard_initialized_v128'
cmd=['/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/nvcc',*['-I'+str(root/p) for p in ['include','algebra/cuda','lib/qdldl/include','lib/amd']],'-std=c++17','-O2','-arch=sm_120','build/performance/qoco_numeric_guard_initialized_v128.cu','-L'+base,'-lqoco','-Xlinker','-rpath','-Xlinker',base,'-o',exe]
r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=[dict(kind='build',command=cmd,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)]
out=Path('artifacts/performance/qoco-numeric-guard-initialized-v128.json')
out.write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print('build',r.returncode,r.stderr,flush=True)
if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
env=dict(os.environ,LD_LIBRARY_PATH=base+':/home/angus/cudss-isolated-0.8.0.10/nvidia/cu12/lib:/usr/local/cuda-12.8/lib64')
with Path('/home/angus/.spacepdhcg-gpu.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 for tool in ['normal','memcheck','initcheck','synccheck']:
  cmd=[exe] if tool=='normal' else ['/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/compute-sanitizer','--tool',tool,'--error-exitcode','98']+(['--leak-check','full'] if tool=='memcheck' else [])+[exe]
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
  rows.append(dict(kind=tool,command=cmd,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr))
  out.write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(tool,r.returncode,r.stdout[-500:],r.stderr,flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def record(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    return dict(sha256=digest(data), lf_sha256=digest(text.replace('\r\n', '\n').encode()), text=text)


out = Path('artifacts/performance/native-numeric-v131-checkpoint.json')
assert not out.exists()
sources = ['cpp/cuda/src/native_qoco_adapter.cpp', 'scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_numeric_replay.py',
           'cpp/cuda/tests/qoco_numeric_replay_probe.cu']
prepared = {}
for version in [127, 128]:
    for name in ['qoco_device_update.cuh', 'cudss_backend.cu', 'qoco_ipm_parameters.cuh',
                 'qoco_ipm_graph.cuh', 'qoco_ipm_replay.cuh', 'qoco_gpu_replay.h']:
        path = Path(f'/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v{version}/source/algebra/cuda/{name}')
        prepared[str(path)] = record(path)
runtimes = {}
paths = [Path(f'/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v{v}/final/libqoco.so') for v in [126, 127, 128]]
paths += [Path('/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-gtoc12-v129/final/libspacepdhcg_cuda.so'),
          Path('/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-ruiz-v77/final/spacepdhcg_plan')]
paths += [Path(f'/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-gtoc12-v{v}/final/{name}') for v in [130, 131]
          for name in ['libspacepdhcg_cuda.so', 'gtoc12_scvx_test', 'qoco_gpu_audit_test']]
paths += [p for p in Path('build/performance').glob('qoco_numeric*') if p.suffix == '']
for p in paths:
    runtimes[str(p)] = dict(sha256=digest(p.read_bytes()), bytes=p.stat().st_size)
rows = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/native-numeric-v131-balanced-paired.json').read_text())
assert len(rows) == 18 and sum(len(r['legs']) for r in rows) == 36
assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 and all(leg['qualified'] for leg in r['legs']) for r in rows)
assert all((r['numeric_replays'] > 0) == bool(r['enabled']) for r in rows)
timing = {v: statistics.median(r['legs'][-1]['seconds'] for r in rows if r['variant'] == v)
          for v in sorted({r['variant'] for r in rows})}
qualifications = 0
for row in rows:
    for leg in row['legs']:
        for r in leg['reports']:
            keys = ['primal_residual', 'dual_residual', 'primal_objective', 'dual_objective', 'relative_gap']
            expected = r['qoco_status'] in [1, 2] and all(isinstance(r[k], (int, float)) and math.isfinite(r[k]) for k in keys)
            expected = expected and max(r['primal_residual'], r['dual_residual'], r['relative_gap']) <= r['requested_tolerance']
            assert bool(r['qualified']) == expected
            qualifications += 1
for mode in ['enabled', 'disabled', 'legacy126']:
    checks = json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/performance/native-replay-v131-{mode}-integration.json').read_text())
    assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 for r in checks) and '51 passed' in checks[-1]['stdout']
bad = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/native-replay-v130-enabled-integration.json').read_text())
assert bad[-1]['returncode'] != 0 and '10 failed, 41 passed' in bad[-1]['stdout']
regression = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/gtoc12-native-replay-v131-regression.json').read_text())
assert regression[0]['returncode'] == 0 and '324 passed' in regression[0]['stdout']
probe = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/qoco-numeric-replay-v128-compare.json').read_text())
assert probe[-1]['returncode'] == 0 and '43 analytic-qualified and 21 retained numerical failures' in probe[-1]['stdout']
refs = [json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/performance/qoco-numeric-reference-v{v}.json').read_text())[-1] for v in [126, 127]]
assert refs[0]['returncode'] == refs[1]['returncode'] == 0 and refs[0]['stdout'] == refs[1]['stdout']
for suffix in ['', '-ruiz3']:
    checks = json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/performance/native-numeric-v131-toggle{suffix}.json').read_text())
